additional_info.body:

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386357-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S3 170003313] OCPP offline CRM:00579001245
additional_info.body:
Hello Thomas,
Greetings of the day!
Please note that, we changed the certain settings on the router to make the stable OCPP connection.
The OCPP was toggling between offline and online. Hence we checked via SSH and found-
Connection type was 2G. So we enabled -> force LTE network to be  4G(LTE)
Also,
It was Showing 2 Mobile (WAN) options in Main WAN section on Teltonika WebUI.
No Wi-Fi (WAN) option in Main WAN section on Teltonika WebUI.
It should show 3 different WAN options in the list.s
- Mobile (WAN)
- Wi-Fi (WAN)
- Wired (WAN)
Hence, we corrected it.
Please refer image below, for Router settings and SIM card.
We monitored the charger and found to be stable OCPP connection now.
Regarding your query-
is it possible to configure the charger in such a way that it allows charging without authorization in case OCPP connectivity is lost?
Yes, it is possible to configure the charger in such a way. But the Authorization has to be there by RFID.
The CPO should set the following OCPP configuration key to True.
AuthorizationCacheEnabled
LocalAuthorizeOffline
LocalAuthListEnabled
Hope this answers your queries.
Do let us know if you have any other queries. We are happy to assist you further.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
